scores.tell: Soft broad sheen on truss and lamp barrel, gentle form turn; slightly cool dark shadows with little contact shadow.
Environment-style lighting. Cast shadows on the lunar ground are soft but the dome has hard glass hot spots and flat grey fill. It reads more like a scene render than the smooth object cards.
Smooth rim and soft top sheen on the orange frame, with a gentle shadow on the face. Very close to the real cards; none notable.
Fuzzy rope coils with soft sheen, a gentle core shadow and no hard hot spots. Matches the real towel card.
Small sharp white droplet highlights and glassy plate reflections. Fruit shading is slightly more realistic and glossy than the smooth cards.
Water caustics and the reflection are scene-level realism. Pier posts are lit evenly with weak form shadow, and the cast shadows are tiny and generic.
Glossy bumper shell with sharp, bright specular streaks and a mirrored floor reflection. The form turn is smooth but the gloss is plastic-like.
Soft, wrapped form turn on the target and bear, with warm bounce. Some plasticky sheen on the shelf, and busy lighting across many objects.
Soft, broad form turn on the column with a clear core shadow. The gold sign has sharp stripe glints, and the rim glow is a bit heavy.
Glossy, tube-like highlights on the pump body, with a flat shadow and a mildly dramatic sunset rim. The scene lighting is more illustrative than the real cards.
